core_obligations: Construct the tightened low-degree and Hadamard-code answer reductions.
Track question length, answer length and verifier complexity through composition to obtain the RE protocol.
difficulty_reason: Develops tighter Reed-Muller answer reduction and a Hadamard-code subset tester, then composes the transformations to reduce answer length to a constant while preserving polynomial question length and constant soundness. Complete answer-reduction protocols and proofs are retained.

dedup.scope: Root checked complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both active lines for exclusive DOI without neighbors. Principal claims count noisy-game NP characterization, noiseless constant-answer RE protocols, standalone deterministic positivity testing, and matrix invariance. Supporting smoothing, hybrid, truncation and answer-reduction lemmas and direct consequences are uncounted.
